**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is planning a lunch outing with colleagues.
- [EVENT] User is considering Subway for the lunch outing.
- [TEMPORAL] The lunch outing is planned for next week.
- [PREFERENCE] User has a previous experience with Subway where the original price of the lunch, including two footlong sandwiches, chips, and drinks, was $23.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Subway is a great option for a quick and easy lunch outing with colleagues.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested combo for a group of 4 includes:
  - 2 Footlong sandwiches (choose 2 different options)
  - Sandwich 1: BMT (Pepperoni, Salami, Ham) or Italian (Salami, Ham, Pepperoni)
  - Sandwich 2: Turkey Breast or Veggie Delite (for a vegetarian option)
  - 1 bag of Chips (suggested flavors: Classic or Sour Cream & Onion)
  - 4 Drinks (fountain drinks or bottled water)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to stay within budget include:
  - Opt for Footlong sandwiches instead of 6-inch sandwiches.
  - Choose a bag of chips instead of individual bags.
  - Consider water or fountain drinks instead of bottled beverages.
  - Adding a cookie or side salad may exceed the $23 budget.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User asked about customizing a Subway sandwich to make it healthier.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for customizing a Subway sandwich to make it healthier, including:
  - Choose whole grain bread.
  - Load up on veggies.
  - Select lean proteins (Turkey Breast, Roast Chicken Breast, Veggie Patty, Tuna).
  - Limit high-fat, high-sodium meats and cheese.
  - Add healthy fats like avocado.
  - Lighten up on sauces and condiments.
  - Opt for lower-sodium options.
  - Customize sandwich size (consider 6-inch).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example of a healthier Subway sandwich includes:
  - Whole wheat bread
  - Turkey Breast or Veggie Patty
  - Loaded with veggies
  - Add avocado or nuts for healthy fats
  - Use mustard or hummus as a spread
  - Opt for low-sodium cheese (if using)
- [USER] Asked about the calorie count of a typical Footlong sandwich.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided approximate calorie counts for popular Footlong sandwiches:
  - BMT Footlong: 960 calories
  - Italian Footlong: 940 calories
  - Turkey Breast Footlong: 760 calories
  - Veggie Delite Footlong: 560 calories
  - Spicy Italian Footlong: 1,040 calories
  - Meatball Marinara Footlong: 1,160 calories
